features.name: PX4-style cascaded drone controller
features.notes: Velocity→attitude→rate→motor cascade with gimbal and zoom control

features.name: Multi-agent delay/staleness/dropout simulation
features.notes: Ringbuffer-based with timestamp guarantees. Fixed calling contract: advance/query split ensures idempotent multi-call per step. Stage order: staleness→latency→FOL→dropout. (2026-03-23)

features.name: Two-layer collision avoidance (CPA + deploy filter)
features.notes: Training-time soft penalty + deployment-time hard filter

features.name: Multi-camera multi-target triangulation with covariance
features.notes: Linear least-squares with condition number check

features.name: Curriculum-driven initial state randomization
features.notes: Cylinder-based placement with curriculum height/orientation/zoom. Tuned for ma5-parity at progress=0 (2026-03-20)

features.name: Debug visualization (frustums, ellipsoids, detection)
features.notes: Camera frustums, LOS indicators, covariance ellipsoids

features.name: Curriculum learning system
features.notes: Safety ramp moved to 60-100k (was 0-20k) to avoid CBF penalty dominating early bbox learning. Backlog: unified randomization architecture (2026-03-20)

features.name: Full environment integration and training
features.notes: Obs redesigned for MA5 parity: 31D ego (body-frame joints, ray_direction_w, combined_ang_vel_w, bbox_aoi) + 16D*(N-1) inter-agent (ray_dir, combined_ang_vel) [+6D tri]. (2026-03-23)

features.name: Experiment registry, training runners, and evaluation pipeline
features.notes: 42 experiments (A1/A3/A4/A5/A6/A7/baselines/sweeps), 4 suites, metric tracker with CBF metrics, greedy baseline with gimbal tracking. Ported from iris_ma5, dropped MLP path. (2026-03-23)
